section: Arkansas corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Top corporate income tax rate (over $11,000)
note: Graduated corporate income tax; 4.3% applies to net income over $11,000 (set by Act 4 of the 2024 Second Extraordinary Session). Lower brackets are in the DFA tax table.
source_title: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration: 2025 Corporation Income Tax Instructions (AR1100CT)

section: Arkansas corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Tax on the first $11,000 of net income
note: Net income up to $11,000 is taxed at lower graduated rates (tax table); above that, $240 plus 4.3% of the excess.
source_title: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration: 2025 Corporation Income Tax Instructions (AR1100CT)

label: Levied by

label: State oversight
value: Arkansas Assessment Coordination Division (Department of Finance and Administration)

label: Assessment increase cap after reappraisal
value: Homestead: 5% per year; other real property: 10% per year (Amendment 79)
note: Caps do not apply to newly discovered property, new construction or substantial improvements.
